topic_summary: This paper presents an on-the-fly machine learning force field (MLFF) generation method integrated into electronic-structure codes using Bayesian inference. The method automatically generates force fields during molecular dynamics simulations, executing first-principles calculations only when encountering new configurations. Applied to calculate melting points of Al, Si, Ge, Sn, and MgO, the method bypasses >99% of first-principles calculations while accelerating simulations by a factor of 1000, achieving quantitative reproduction of first-principles melting points validated by thermodynamic perturbation theory.
key_points: On-the-fly MLFF generation using Bayesian inference automatically creates force fields during MD simulations
First-principles calculations executed only for new configurations outside existing datasets
